## About
Kelly & Stan's Automotive was started by Kelly Wilson and Stan McPherson, who worked together for years at an independent Mercedes repair shop in North Fulton County before opening their own place in Roswell.
Stan is from the area, a Sprayberry graduate who got into cars building hotrods and went on to become an ASE-certified Master Technician specializing in Japanese and European imports. Kelly came up through parts and service management and is known for taking the time to understand each customer's situation and what their car actually needs.
From scheduled maintenance and check engine lights to A/C repair, engine work, brakes and suspension, the goal is simple: do good work, be straight with people, and earn the kind of trust that gets you referred to family, friends and neighbors. Customers have given the shop a 5 star rating across 184 Google reviews.

## Services
- Keeping your car well serviced: Service to keep your car on the road and running well.
- Check engine light diagnostics: Finding out what that light means and what your car needs.
- Brakes and suspension: Inspection and repair of brakes and suspension.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Most European and Japanese vehicles, including Mercedes, BMW, Toyota and Honda.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment or ask a question?
A: You can fill out the contact form, email Kelly at kelly@kellyandstans.com, or give the shop a call.

Q: What if my car needs a tow?
A: For towing assistance, the shop points customers to United Towing at 770-751-0581.
